name: Fearsome
text: This fighter gains the `TERRIFYING` keyword.

name: Drillmaster
text: When earning renown in the aftermath sequence, if this fighter wasn't taken out of action in the battle, you may select an additional `HENCHMAN` to be marked for greatness.

name: Oppressor
text: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter makes the Retreat action, this fighter can make the 'Strike Them Down' reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Staggering Blows
text: Whenever this fighter scores a critical hit with a melee attack action, the target cannot use reactions or abilities for the rest of the battle round.

name: Weapon Master
text: Select a melee weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, add 1 to its critical damage characteristic.

name: Shield Bash
text: This fighter can use a shield to make off-hand attacks. The attack deals no damage, but if the hit roll scores a hit or critical hit, the target makes a free Retreat action. You get to decide where it goes.

name: Maintain Momentum
text: When this fighter uses the Onslaught ability, it affects each melee attack action they make until the end of their activation, instead of only their next one.

name: Executioner's Strike
text: Legendary ability. This fighter makes a free attack action. Increase the Hit Damage and Critical Damage of that attack action by (X/2).

name: Second Wind
text: Each time this fighter is activated, if it is wounded, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

name: Nine Lives
text: When rolling for permanent injuries, this fighter can re-roll the first result of 11-12. The second result stands.

name: Tough as Nails
text: Increase this fighter's Health characteristic by 4.

name: Bulwark
text: When equipped with a shield, friendly fighters within 1" of this fighter are considered to be in cover.

name: Endure
text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by an attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1) from that attack action.

name: Bodyguard
text: Select a friendly `HERO` within 1" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, while that `HERO` remains within 1" of this fighter, they cannot be targeted by attack actions.

name: Indomitable
text: Legendary ability. A fighter can only use this ability if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. Remove up to 10 damage points allocated to this fighter.

name: Acrobatic
text: This fighter can end Retreat actions within 1" of enemy fighters.

name: Duelist
text: Once per battle round, this fighter can make the 'Counter' reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Infiltrator
text: When this fighter is deployed to the battlefield, it may immediately make a free move action, as long as it ends that move action more than 6" from enemy fighters.

name: Wall-Runner
text: When this fighter makes the Move action, they may ignore the first 3" moved vertically when climbing or falling.

name: Stealthy
text: When this fighter is targeted by a ranged attack action, it is considered to be in cover if it is more than 6" away from the attacking fighter.

name: Step-Aside
text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before any hit rolls are made. Roll 1 dice for each successful hit. On a 4+, that hit counts as a miss and is discarded.

name: Disengage
text: A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 1" of an enemy fighter. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Rain of Blows
text: Legendary ability. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Eagle Eyes
text: When making an attack action using a bow, crossbow or handgun, this fighter may ignore the maximum range of the weapon, but if they do, they must subtract 1 from their Shoot characteristic.

name: Reckless
text: This fighter may target enemy fighters within 1" of friendly fighters with ranged attack actions. If they do, after making the hit rolls, roll a dice. On a 1, allocate the damage to one of the friendly fighters instead of the target.

name: Rapid Reload
text: At the end of each battle round, you may reload one of this fighter's weapons with the Reload special rule.

name: Scout
text: After making an exploration roll in the aftermath sequence, if the bearer is in the search party, you may resolve two encounters instead of one, even if one of the encounters is a mishap.

name: Surgical Precision
text: This fighter's weapons gain the Piercing 1 weapon rule.

name: Trick Shot
text: When this fighter makes a ranged attack action, the target does not count as being in cover.

name: Patient Hunter
text: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter ends a move action visible to this fighter, this fighter can target that enemy fighter with a free ranged attack action. For that attack action, subtract 1 from this fighter's Shoot characteristic.

name: Killing Shot
text: Legendary ability. For this fighter's next ranged attack action, add (X/2) to its Shoot, Hit Damage and Critical Damage characteristics.

name: Bootlicker
text: When collecting income in the aftermath sequence, if this fighter was not taken out of action, your warband earns 1 additional favour.

name: Charismatic
text: Once per battle, this fighter can use the 'Inspiring Presence' ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so.

name: Master Tactician
text: `LEADER` only. When seizing the initiative in the initiative phase, if there is a tie, do not roll off. Instead the player controlling this fighter chooses which tied player has the initiative. If multiple warbands have this talent, the players of those warbands roll off, and the winner chooses which tied player has the initiative.

name: Well-Connected
text: Once per battle when recruiting a `HIRED SWORD`, roll a dice. On a 4+, you may reduce the hiring fee by 50% (rounding up).

name: Fall Back!
text: A fighter can make this reaction after they have been allocated the total damage points by a melee attack action. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Warcry
text: Select each friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter. Those fighters are no longer panicked, and do not have to take Bravery tests until the end of the battle round.

name: Coordinated Assault
text: Legendary ability. Select 3 friendly `HENCHMEN` within 6" of this fighter. Each selected fighter makes either a free move action, a free retreat action, or a free attack action.
